params.name: imgs
params.let: [m * a + c for a in X]

stem: If $X={=setof(X)}$, $Y={=setof(Y)}$, and R is a relation from X to Y where $a\,R\,b$ means «$b = {=m}a + {=c}$», for each $a \in X$, $b \in Y$. Write R as a set of ordered pairs. Only pairs whose second element belongs to Y are in R.
solution: When $a={=X[1]}$: $b={=m}\times({=X[1]})+{=c}={=imgs[1]}$, which is not in Y, so $a={=X[1]}$ gives no pair
$\therefore R=${=setof([pair(X[0], imgs[0]), pair(X[2], imgs[2]), pair(X[3], imgs[3])])}
notes: Advanced: negative elements, multiplier and constant, and one element of X has an image outside Y (as in the book, where 4 in Y is unused and rule must be checked against Y). Y is built so imgs[1] is excluded, imgs[0], imgs[2], imgs[3] included; the extra element imgs[3]+1 exceeds every image, so it is never an image.
